shared_elements: repeated row of similar shapes along the top
justification: Both are stone surfaces carved in low relief with profile animals, a bird form and small anthropomorphic figures, and both use a horizontal band to separate a row of repeated motifs from the main field, which is the most specific correspondence. However, A is a tall vertical panel with stacked, isolated, flat and schematic outline figures on a rough weathered block, whereas B is a wide horizontal frieze of densely overlapping, anatomically modelled figures organised into a single narrative procession with wheeled vehicle and armed men — different formats, densities and levels of carving skill.
